cases.name: Meriam Macario Kuyosawa
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was born on June 28, 1974 in the Philippines. Meriam was employed as a cafeteria worker for Sodexo. She was a member of St. Jerome Catholic Church and served as a youth program volunteer. Other memberships included; Philippine-American Community of the Peninsula (PACP), One Heart for Hope Foundation and International Children Festival (ICF)."
